programmes.d: When Hunter disappears during an investigation of organized crime, McCall and her new partner must find him before he's killed.
Vinnie goes undercover as a garment center security consultant to keep the new wave of organized crime leadership from destroying a family business.
Another side of Eli is revealed when his son David is reported missing while on an overseas business trip.
While David and Eli move to close their most important knock-off dress deal ever, Pinzolo uses the same deal in an attempt to bury Eli and Elrose Fashions for good.
With a local history of tainted trick-or-treat candy, concerned Eastbridge parents pressure Tony to protect their children from the suspect, an eccentric recluse.
Tony is torn when a series of life-threatening incidents occur in Eastbridge and the only link appears to be an old, mild-mannered friend currently experiencing marital difficulties.
Tony is distraught when it appears that his friend may be targeted for revenge by a dangerous escaped convict.
While investigating a murder, McCall is shot and paralyzed after learning about a prostitution ring operating along the highway in a fleet of motor homes.
As doctors prepare to operate on the paralyzed McCall, Hunter races against time to exonerate himself and find whoever is killing potential witnesses in a deadly prostitution case.
